name: Quebec

flag.description: A white cross on a blue field, with a white fleur-de-lis upright in each of the four quarters.
flag.symbolism: The white cross and fleurs-de-lis recall the Christian and royal French heritage of New France.

hook: Quebec's Fleurdelisé is a white cross on blue with a white fleur-de-lis in every corner: four lilies for New France.
trivia: The Fleurdelisé was first raised over Quebec's Parliament Building on 21 January 1948, the day it was adopted.
Quebec is the only Canadian province whose sole official language is French.
